svg.aria-label: AWS account day zero: root locked away, people through Identity Center, everything recorded
svg.title: AWS account day zero: root locked away, people through Identity Center, everything recorded
svg.text: AWS account day zero: root locked away, people through Identity Center, everything recorded
The baseline applied before the first workload: one identity nobody uses, short-lived access for people, and account-wide logging, detection and safe defaults.
Registered on root, stored apart under dual
Root keys cannot be limited by any policy
In an Organization: member accounts lose root
MFA every time they sign in
People are assigned to groups, never to accounts
Temporary role credentials, no IAM users
A cost spike is often the first sign of stolen access keys, which is why the budget alarm is part of the security baseline.
Root: 2 keys, 0 access keys. People: 3 groups, sessions of 1 to 4 hours. Controls supported: AC-2, AC-6(5), IA-2(1), AU-2, AU-12, SI-4, SC-28; CIS AWS Foundations 1 to 4.
Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not AWS artwork.
